_comment: Intentional differences between the Jekyll baseline and the Next.js build. Every entry here is a deliberate decision, not a bug. Keep it short and keep it justified.

_schema.ignoreMissing: URL globs allowed to disappear from the new build (* matches anything).
_schema.ignoreExtra: URL globs allowed to be new in the new build.
_schema.ignoreFields: Page fields skipped on every page: title canonical description ogImage ogUrl robots jsonLdTypes h1Count headingIds.
_schema.ignorePageFields: Per-URL field skips, e.g. {"/about/": ["description"]}. Use ["*"] to skip a page entirely.
_schema.renames: Baseline URL -> candidate URL, for URLs that intentionally moved. The old URL must get a redirect.

_ignoreMissingReasons./scripts/*: Build tooling. _config.yml has no `exclude:`, so Jekyll copied the whole scripts/ tree into _site and published it (including translation_errors.log). Never linked, never intended to be public; the Next.js build does not copy it.
_ignoreMissingReasons./README.md: Repo documentation accidentally published by the same missing `exclude:`. Not linked from anywhere and not part of the site.
_ignoreMissingReasons./CNAME: GitHub Pages is retired (site now on Vercel); CNAME was the GH Pages domain file and is intentionally not served anymore.
_ignoreMissingReasons./assets/css/*: The per-page stylesheets under assets/css/ were consolidated into /css/main.css, which every page already loads. Assets, not content: nothing indexes or deep-links a stylesheet, and the only references were the <link> tags on the pages that moved into main.css.

_ignoreExtraReasons./404/*: Next emits both /404.html (the GitHub Pages contract, present in the baseline) and a /404/ directory.
_ignoreExtraReasons./_not-found/: Next's internal catch-all route, exported as a directory. GitHub Pages serves /404.html for unknown paths regardless.
_ignoreExtraReasons./*__next*.txt, /*/index.txt: RSC flight payloads that Next's static export writes next to every prerendered page. Inert for crawlers; not addressable content.
_ignoreExtraReasons./assets/translations/*/.gitkeep: Empty placeholder files copied by scripts/next/sync-public.mjs; Jekyll skipped dotfiles.
_ignoreExtraReasons./docs/*.md: sync-public.mjs copies docs/*.md into public/. Jekyll rendered them as pages instead, so the raw markdown was never published. Harmless (the markdown twins at /docs/<slug>/index.md are the advertised representation).
